title: Rust DIO source binding accepts arbitrary prefix aliases
description: Authenticated DIO parsing compares only IPv6 source IID to signer IID and does not require the control-plane source to be link-local fe80::/64 (or another explicitly allowed canonical prefix). A signed Rule255 DIO can use arbitrary 64-bit prefixes with the signer-owned IID; Router keys neighbors/parents by the full address, enabling one signer to create bounded-table aliases. Enforce canonical source scope and add alias/capacity/root/peer vector tests.
